segments.title: Robert Downey Jr. Masturbation Confession & Peaky Blinders Discussion
segments.notes: Case Blackwell anchors solo with Chet Manscape interrupting; covers RDJ's Sunday Times interview about chronic masturbation during Iron Man filming, Killian Murphy's praise, and a confused discussion of Oppenheimer cast photos.

segments.title: Hand Game Debate: Crum vs. Robert Downey Jr.
segments.notes: Munch and Crum debate who has stronger hand game; Crum claims he can crush a golf ball and snap his penis in half, Munch argues RDJ has judo-trained grip strength; Munch wins by fiat.

segments.title: Transition to Therapy & Remington Mayoral Confusion
segments.notes: Case wraps debate, discusses Remington mayoral situation (Shamroko Johnson possibly mayor), suggests Crum and Munch run for president, then pivots to therapy.

segments.title: Crum's Nummy Rag Breakthrough
segments.notes: Crum undergoes therapy with Dr. Chath; reveals childhood 'nummy rag' incident at age 11 involving great-grandmother's blanket; forced to 'do the shrew stuff' and roleplay as a varmint; achieves emotional breakthrough.

segments.title: Lethal Company Marathon with John Madison, Tim Lampier, Griffin Winsler & Crew
segments.notes: Case hosts extended Lethal Company session (not a canonical BIN segment); multiple recruits join via Steam; crew navigates flooded moons, turret guns, giants, bees, and space fleas; meets quota after many deaths.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: lead anchor. Anchors news block, moderates Munch & Crum debate, hosts therapy handoff, then runs 3-hour Lethal Company session as captain/first mate.

characters.name: Chet (Chet Manscape)
characters.notes: science correspondent. Interrupts news open with 'science' trigger; debates cult branding, mocks Case's masturbation clicks, delivers outro before being cut off.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Revealed as the dog's name on air; appears briefly during therapy transition, asserts new identity.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Returns from 'vacation' to debate Crum on hand game; claims RDJ's judo grip wins; declares himself Crum's 'daddy' and banishes him to Netherrealm.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Claims superior hand game (crush golf ball, snap penis), reveals nummy rag trauma in therapy, forced into shrew roleplay, achieves breakthrough.

characters.name: Dr. Chath
characters.notes: therapist. Conducts Crum's therapy session; reads chat prompts; guides Crum through nummy rag confrontation and shrew roleplay to breakthrough.

lore_notes.fact: Officially named on-air as the dog/executive producer; previously unnamed.
Reveals childhood 'nummy rag' incident at age 11 involving great-grandmother Martha's blanket; first sexual experience was accidental onto the blanket.
Claims hand game strength: can crush a golf ball and snap own penis in half; asserts 'super strength in spits'.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell returns for a Friday news broadcast covering Robert Downey Jr.'s masturbation confession, then oversees a Munch & Crum debate on hand-game supremacy won by Munch. Crum undergoes a therapy session with Dr. Chath that exposes his 'nummy rag' childhood trauma and forces a shrew roleplay breakthrough. The broadcast concludes with a three-hour Lethal Company marathon featuring John Madison, Tim Lampier, Griffin Winsler, and rotating recruits, where the crew barely meets quota after repeated deaths on flooded moons.
